population: 15 already exposed benchmark errors from two complete old pools of48 each; adaptive developmental audit
selection: three visual attribute disagreements with executable geometric actions; source labels and outcomes already known; no blinding or independent testing claim
intervention: current-case regional magnification retaining originals; question-dependent finite geometry, no learned policy
arms: same additional review plus executed crop-tool output
order: C03 review then operation; C11 operation then review; C13 review then operation
endpoints: paired benchmark option changes and gain/loss
whether independent process truth and transfer evidence exist
positive_skill_rule: A benchmark gain is only a repair candidate. Verified medical skill requires independently established observation, action correctness, and transfer beyond these exposed cases. Unknown prerequisites are reported as unknown, never pass.
failure_rule: no regeneration/format rescue/crop retuning/repeat; record errors and planned6 denominator; stop at original deadline and64MB; all six finish before outcome aggregation
controller_interface: single structured visual review using subscription transport; not the full six-tool MedRAX workflow
limitations: Source labels were available during candidate triage
Crop arm adds image and token cost; not token-matched
No correct-case harm panel, no repeatability, no independently held-out transfer
